source: NBER, Infant Births and Deaths by State, 1920-1945 (workbook by Douglas Norton, 2007, with a 'Norberg Data' sheet; Karen Norberg's transcription of the printed volumes)
url: https://www.nber.org/research/data (NBER Public Use Data Archive, set titled Infant Births and Deaths by State, 1920-1945; the exact page address was not recorded)

file.name: state_infant_deaths_births_1920-1945.xls
file.saved: by the owner from his own browser, 2026-10-10

terms: No terms of use in the workbook's README sheet; it names the author (Douglas Norton) and says bold values are imputed from a five-year trend where a state-year is missing (and interpolated between available years). Terms status none_stated.

checks.cross_check: infant_deaths equals Miller's all_under_1 on all 727 overlapping non-imputed state-years (1920-1936)

note: Imputed values are flagged *_imputed = true and keep their fractional value; use or drop them knowingly. The 'US total' rows are not carried. Not used by the build.
